message.content: {"question":"If a=-kv where k is a constant, determine v=v(t) and x=x(t) knowing that x(t=0)=0 and v(t=0)=0","options":{"A":"x(t)=-exp(-kt)/k-t+1/k; v(t)=exp(-kt)-1","B":"x(t)=-exp(-kt)-t+1; v(t)=exp(-kt)-1","C":"x(t)=-exp(-kt)/k-t; v(t)=exp(-kt)","D":"x(t)=-exp(-kt)/k-t; v(t)=exp(-kt)-1"},"correct":"A"}
